scope: Server implementation and fictional response tests; no live provider credentials, network requests, catalog writes, inventory writes, deployment or merchant data.

official_sources.supports: POST /oauth2/token/status returns actual scopes, merchant_id, client_id and expires_at; documented Authorization context requires a valid production credential.
Token introspection verifies permissions without inferring them from successful unrelated calls or the requested authorization scopes.
Catalog upserts require ITEMS_WRITE and inventory changes require INVENTORY_WRITE. Request only permissions needed by enabled capabilities.

implementation.production_proof: Exact configured application, saved merchant, saved environment, finite unexpired OAuth token and actual granted required scopes. Recheck saved token connection after provider response.
implementation.credentials: Token remains in an ephemeral server-only object with redacted repr; proof projection contains no token or application secret.
implementation.transport: Fixed provider origin, explicit no redirects, TLS verification retained, environment proxy disabled, 20-second request timeout, bounded 64 KiB streamed token-status JSON.
implementation.status_endpoint: Saved connection is separate from granted-scope proof. scopes is empty; requested_scopes is labeled and grants_verified is false without introspection.
implementation.sandbox: Actionable unavailable status before any token or provider call. No fallback treating requested scopes as actual grants.
implementation.existing_oauth_scopes: Unchanged read-only request list. Receiving re-consent and typed write adapter remain separate implementation/release gates.
implementation.legacy_requests: OAuth token exchange and existing resource reads reject redirects and non-200 responses.

tests.focused_result: 27 cases passed with fictional responses; broad source-bound acceptance pending integration.
covered: revocation or token replacement during introspection
